title: US-Soviet deconfliction on UFOs and NATO collaboration

tellings.quote: deterrence and the deconliction, as we already know, established between the United States and the Soviet Union on UFOs.

plain: Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official who has come forward as a whistleblower, says the United States and the Soviet Union set up arrangements on UFOs for deterrence and "deconfliction", meaning ways to make sure neither side mistook a UFO event for an attack by the other. He presents this as already known, and links it to cooperation within NATO, the Western military alliance.
